title: eludite.build.solution input
description: Build the open workspace (Build > Build Solution, Ctrl+Shift+B or F6): the .NET solution out of process in eludite-host (`dotnet build` for SDK-style solutions, the located MSBuild (Mono's on Linux and macOS, Build Tools' on Windows) when the solution has legacy projects), and the Cargo workspace with `cargo build --message-format=json-diagnostic-rendered-ansi`, run by the shell off the UI thread (brief 0019). Which of the two runs is `system`. The Output window shows the log as it streams, the Error List the build's errors and warnings next to the live ones, the status bar the progress. One build at a time: while one runs this fails, and the Build menu's items are disabled.

configuration.description: Debug or Release (or another configuration the solution file lists). Omitted: the configuration selected in the IDE (Debug by default).

platform.description: A platform the solution file lists, for example Any CPU or x64. Omitted: the platform selected in the IDE (the solution's default).

system.description: Which build system builds (brief 0019): msbuild (the .NET solution, through eludite-host), cargo (the Cargo workspace, `cargo build` run by the shell) or all (each the workspace has, MSBuild first, one after the other, into the same Output pane and Error List). Omitted: the system that owns the active document (a .rs file belongs to cargo, a file of the solution to msbuild), or all when no document is active or the active one belongs to neither.

wait.description: Wait for the build to finish and return its result (the default for a caller off the UI thread, such as an agent). false: return as soon as the build starts, with state running. A caller on the UI thread (menus, keys) never waits. A waiting call ends early, with state canceled, when the build is canceled (eludite.build.cancel).
